items.title: Serena Williams, 44, Targeting Summer Comeback - Forbes
items.summary: I'm a basketball and tennis insider. Serena Williams, 44, will reportedly return to the tennis court in doubles with partner Victoria Mboko at Queens Club, which runs June 8-14 in London. It’s possible that if things go well for Williams in doubles, she could opt to ask for a wildcard into the Wimbledon singles draw. X (Formerly Twitter)Tennis Channel on X (formerly Twitter): "Serena Williams will reportedly make a return to tennis at Queens 2026 🚨 She has requested a doubles wildcard to play alongside Victoria Mboko, per Jon Wertheim via Served. Williams, considered by many the GOATGOAT of women’s tennis, was listed by the sport's drug testing organization as eligible to return to competition on Feb. 22. In December, when rumors first began that Williams might return, she posted on X/Twitter: “Omg yall I’m NOT coming back. Still, by reentering the testing pool, she gave herself the opportunity to compete in 2026 – in doubles and/or singles – should she choose.

items.title: Israeli officials condemn Netanyahu's response to Donald Trump, canceled Lebanon strike - The Jerusalem Post
items.summary: # Time to say no to Trump: Israeli officials condemn Netanyahu's decision to cancel Lebanon strike. ## “This is the time to tell our friend, President Trump - ‘no’,” National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir wrote on X/Twitter. Multiple Israeli officials took to social media to criticize Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s decision to cancel a strike on Beirut at the urging of US President Donald Trump on Monday. “This is the time to tell our friend, President Trump - ‘no’,” National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir wrote on X/Twitter, reminding Netanyahu that he once said a strong prime minister would be able to tell the president of the US no when necessary. Former prime minister and competitor in the race for Israel’s next prime minister, Naftali Bennett, wrote that the government had “lost control over Israeli sovereignty” and pledged to restore security to the citizens of Israel.

items.title: GTA 6 Was Supposed to Come Out Today, May 26 — and According to Rockstar's Official Twitter Account, It Still Does - IGN Southeast Asia
items.summary: # GTA 6 Was Supposed to Come Out Today, May 26 — and According to Rockstar's Official Twitter Account, It Still Does. “Grand Theft Auto VI is now set to release on May 26, 2026.” That was the announcement Rockstar Games issued on May 2, 2025, confirming a delay from the game’s original fall 2025 release window. Let’s start with the remarkable fact that Rockstar Games’ current pinned tweet, published on May 6, 2025, is the GTA 6 Trailer 2 video, which includes the May 26, 2026 release date. So yes, according to Rockstar Games’ official X / Twitter account, GTA 6 is out today. While you wait to find out, we’ve got plenty more on GTA 6 for you to read, including Zelnick’s comments on whether GTA 6 even needs a Trailer 3, his thoughts on the current console install base (GTA 6 isn’t coming out on PC at launch), and how GTA 6 is actually delayed around 18 months, not a year.

items.title: Jake Worthington pauses career to prioritize family and self-care - walls 102
items.summary: Mon - Fri: 10:00 AM - 03:00 PM. Facebook-f     Icon-twitter-x     Instagram. The singer shared that he needs to step away in order to “work on myself for my wife and daughter.”. I love my family my friends and my fans too much to let it take over me. I need to take some time to work on myself for my wife and daughter. I promise I will come back even better,” before concluding with, “God bless Country Music.”. Additionally, he will no longer be opening for Luke Combs during his late May and early June stadium stops in Montreal and Toronto. As of now, his official calendar is set to resume on July 24th at The Great Texas Mosquito Festival in Clute, Texas, with additional performances booked through the remainder of the year. items.title: As trade looms, A.J. Brown is absent from Twitter - Yahoo Sports
items.summary: # As trade looms, A.J. Brown is absent from Twitter. It's trading day (potentially) for Eagles receiver A.J. Brown. We don't know when it was specifically deleted, but it currently is gone. Regardless of when Brown left Twitter, he could be leaving Philly very soon. A trade agreement could be reported or announcement at any time. It can't be finalized until 4:01 p.m. ET on Monday. It won't become official (or officially official, as some still insist on saying) until Tuesday. Regardless, no one believes Brown will be back with the Eagles for a fifth season. Regardless, the window on spreading the dead-money charge over two years opens for the Eagles at 4:01 p.m. ET on Monday. And with Brown absent from Twitter, he won't have to hear directly from Eagles fans when they wish him well, or otherwise, on the way out the door.
